Title: Shell command injection in legacy metadata processing
Vector_Rationale: Authenticated attacker controls an upload field; if sent through the shell, code runs with service privileges. Scope U assumes app and helper run in one application security authority.
Control_Plan: Replace shell with argv array, fixed executable, input validation, timeout; least-privilege runtime

Title: SQL injection in metadata queries
Vector_Rationale: Untrusted string enters SQL if dynamic concatenation exists; network-reachable to authenticated user and can affect whole CaseVault data store.

Title: Filename/path traversal reaches private files
Vector_Rationale: Authenticated upload controls filename; if reused as filesystem path, unintended private objects could be overwritten/read.
Control_Plan: Opaque paths generated by server; private store outside public root; normalization

Title: IDOR permits unauthorized read plus grant modification
Vector_Rationale: Authenticated unprivileged user manipulates evidence ID; absent object-level checks could expose files and modify grants; no assumed availability impact.
Control_Plan: Centralize owner/grantee checks for each object; live revocation; deny by default

Title: IDOR permits unauthorized evidence delete
Vector_Rationale: Authenticated user could delete another user’s evidence where ownership validation is absent; high integrity and availability impact.
Control_Plan: Owner-only deletion, transactional metadata+file cleanup and denial tests

Title: CSRF causes unauthorized grant or deletion
Vector_Rationale: Remote attacker needs a signed-in victim to visit attacker-controlled origin; attacker holds no CaseVault account. Assumes forged sensitive action changes grant state.
Control_Plan: Session-bound CSRF tokens, SameSite, POST-only state changes, Origin checks where relevant

Title: Native helper buffer overflow
Vector_Rationale: Authenticated upload reaches unsafe C buffer; memory exploitation is assumed to need additional heap/stack conditions (AC:H). Worst-case impact is modeled, not confirmed RCE.
Control_Plan: Enforce length limits in Python/C; bounded copy; ASAN; compiler hardening; isolate helper

Title: Session forgery under weak secret
Vector_Rationale: Network attacker needs exposed/guessable session signing secret; extra condition motivates AC:H, but high account compromise impact.
Control_Plan: High-entropy environment secret; signed expiry; HttpOnly, session invalidation

Title: Missing authentication rate limit
Vector_Rationale: Automated guessing needs correct credentials to succeed; account lockout/throttling is deployment hardening P1.
Control_Plan: Per-account/IP throttling, event monitoring, MFA if deployed externally

Title: Clickjacking causes victim action
Vector_Rationale: Requires victim click on framed authenticated UI, with potential unauthorized share; lower direct disclosure than direct IDOR.
Control_Plan: CSP frame-ancestors none and X-Frame-Options DENY; browser test

Title: Remote traffic intercept without TLS
Vector_Rationale: Adjacent network position assumed when deployed over plaintext HTTP; local HTTP is acceptable only in isolated lab.
Control_Plan: Terminate HTTPS in real deployment; Secure cookies and redirects

Title: Oversized upload exhausts storage or workers
Vector_Rationale: Authenticated user sends repeated/large uploads if limits absent; potential serious service availability loss.
Control_Plan: Bounded streaming, size quota and fail cleanup, health monitoring

Title: Non-privileged read path bypasses revocation
Vector_Rationale: Previously granted user can reuse stale authorization after revoke if service caches outdated permission checks.
Control_Plan: Recheck live grants on each download; revoke integration test

Title: Tampering with evidence not detected
Vector_Rationale: User with local write access could modify file bytes if digest verification not performed; local attack and existing access assumed.
Control_Plan: SHA-256 at ingest and recheck at download; protect metadata/digest

Title: Sensitive data leaked through error or audit log
Vector_Rationale: Local log reader with limited access could view accidentally printed tokens, paths or secret data.
Control_Plan: Structured redaction, generic client errors, access-restricted logs

Title: Upload validator failure allows process termination
Vector_Rationale: Malformed metadata triggers uncaught helper crash or unbounded wait; assumed partial uptime impact.
Control_Plan: Strict bounds, timeout, controlled nonzero error handling
